title: Plan Schema v2
description: Canonical YAML-frontmatter schema for SGSD v2 PLAN.md files

required.semantic_acceptance_criteria: plan must declare 'semantic_acceptance_criteria' array with >=1 entry (SCHEMA-09)

schema_version.description: v2 plans skip spawned classifier agents (SCHEMA-04)

semantic_acceptance_criteria.description: Each entry: a falsifiable claim that a real-world input produces a specific outcome (DLB-07, SCHEMA-09).

expected_ATC_tier.description: ATC review tier for this plan (D-01). Default LITE; declare only when NOT LITE.

skip_gates.description: Phase-10 gate IDs to bypass for this plan (D-03). Default empty = run all gates.

depends_on.description: Plan IDs that must complete before this plan dispatches (D-05).

lessons_path.description: Path to a lessons-learned file for this plan (D-04). Missing file: warn + continue.

prior_errors_lookup.description: Tier-sensitive: true for FULL/GATE, false for LITE/SKIP (D-02). Parser derives; not validated here.

input.description: Description of the real-world input the verification command exercises.

expected_outcome.description: What the system must produce for the input to pass.

verification_cmd.description: Shell command that runs against real data and exits 0 iff expected_outcome holds.

required.files_touched: task must declare 'files_touched' array with >=1 entry (SCHEMA-02)

id.description: Unique task identifier within this plan (SCHEMA-02).

agent.description: Agent dispatched for this task, e.g. gsd-executor (SCHEMA-02).

model.description: Model routed to the agent; used for classifier-skip derivation (SCHEMA-02, SCHEMA-04).

files_touched.description: Files created or modified by this task. At least one required (SCHEMA-02).

input_contract.description: What this task expects as input (referenced docs, prior outputs) (SCHEMA-02).

output_contract.description: What this task produces and where it lands (SCHEMA-02).

hypothesis.description: Testable claim about why this task achieves its goal (SCHEMA-02).

falsifier.description: Condition that would prove the hypothesis wrong (SCHEMA-02).

stop_rule.description: Observable state that means the task is complete (SCHEMA-02).

depends_on.description: Task IDs within this plan that must complete first (D-05).

known_deadends.description: Approaches already tried and abandoned; executor skips these (D-05).

verification_cmd.description: Shell command to verify task output. Null = fall back to verifier agent (D-05).

prior_errors_lookup.description: Override D-02 tier-sensitive default for this specific task. Parser derives when absent.

expected_ATC_tier.description: Per-task ATC tier override (D-01). Inherits plan-level tier when absent.

skip_gates.description: Gate IDs to bypass for this specific task (D-03).

lessons_path.description: Task-specific lessons-learned file (D-04). Missing file: warn + continue.
